symptom: Uncertainty about confirmed_flush_lsn, restart_lsn, replay, and when WAL can be recycled
checkpoint: Inspect slot restart_lsn, confirmed_flush_lsn, wal_status, safe_wal_size and consumer durability semantics.

symptom: After switchover, slot synchronization refuses a same-name slot whose synced flag is false
checkpoint: Compare failover and synced flags on both nodes; do not drop or recreate a slot during diagnosis.

topic: Logical replication slots after repeated failovers
symptom: Reported failover slot properties differ after repeated Patroni failovers
checkpoint: Capture node identity, recovery state and complete slot rows from every node before attributing a server defect.

topic: Continuity of WAL archiving across promotion
symptom: Archive may have a timeline-one WAL gap when a lagging primary archiver fails before standby promotion
checkpoint: Inspect archive lag, last archived and failed WAL, timelines, and whether standby archiving is configured.

topic: Logical parallel apply lag and lock timeouts
symptom: Parallel logical apply accumulates large replay lag while workers wait or exit
checkpoint: Correlate subscription worker states, waits, locks, WAL generation and publisher/subscriber LSNs; do not label ordinary worker waits as deadlocks.

topic: Incremental backup after segmented relation truncation
symptom: pg_basebackup finishes but pg_combinebackup cannot restore an incremental backup after VACUUM truncates a relation larger than one segment
checkpoint: Record exact server version, relation segmentation, backup chain and pg_combinebackup error; prove restoration in an isolated environment.

topic: Interrupted crash recovery after pg_wal filled
symptom: Recovery is interrupted by no space left on device and later succeeds, after emitting a possible-corruption hint
checkpoint: Preserve logs, verify storage and checksums where available, and test recovery from a known backup before making assurance claims.

topic: Major upgrade of a streaming-replication cluster
symptom: Unclear sequencing for pgpool, primary, standbys, slots and rebuilding terabyte-scale replicas during pg_upgrade
checkpoint: Inventory versions, extensions, slots, topology and rollback evidence; rehearse the documented upgrade and standby rebuild plan.

topic: pg_dump, pg_restore and TOAST during rollback planning
symptom: Schema size appears smaller than pg_toast and operators are unsure whether dumped tables include TOAST data
checkpoint: Account for TOAST as table storage, verify archive contents and perform a target-version restore rehearsal.

topic: Large data-only restore permissions and performance
symptom: A multi-terabyte pg_restore --data-only encounters role switching, retry cleanup, WAL and index-build concerns
checkpoint: Inspect archive TOC, ownership and target privileges; benchmark a full isolated restore rather than treating dump completion as recoverability.
